model: Linear in Fisher-z space, non-negative weights learned on 7 yearly origins and ridge-shrunk toward the v1 hand weights; PLOS = 100 x predicted future correlation (clipped at 0). Per-layer contributions are exact Shapley values against 'no overlap on any layer'.

descriptions.Q1_residual_corr: Co-movement after removing the market and mid-cap factors (shared stock picking)
descriptions.Q2_factor_similarity: Similarity of exposure to the Nifty 50 and Nifty Midcap 50 factors
descriptions.Q4_holdings_implied_corr: Correlation implied by TODAY's holdings: weights x shrunk stock covariance
descriptions.Q5_style_similarity: Similarity of sector-style exposures (Sharpe style analysis on 9 Nifty sector indices)
descriptions.H1_weighted_overlap: Share of money in the same stocks: sum of min(weight A, weight B)
descriptions.H2_jaccard: Share of stock names held in common (Jaccard)
descriptions.H3_top10_jaccard: Overlap of the top-10 conviction holdings

validation.method: 7 yearly origins 2019-2025: layers from the 2 years before each origin, target = correlation of weekly returns over the next year. Primary test: rolling temporal (train on earlier origins only, predict each of the last 4 years). Secondary: leave-one-scheme-out.
findings: Gradient-boosted trees won leave-one-scheme-out but were WORST forward in time: they overfit the market-wide correlation level of particular years.
Scoring correlations in Fisher-z alone lifted the v1 hand weights from 0.57 to 0.63 R^2.
The holdings-implied layer is weak for older years (the factsheet holdings are from 2026) and strongest for the latest year, where the holdings are current.
